The comparable whole-pattern score is unavailable, and the reported approximately 0.999 correlation comes from a custom profile fit over selected reflection windows rather than an independently comparable Rwp. The trajectory's symmetry search was interrupted after space group 162, and only the chosen P321 special-position arrangement was fully coordinate-refined; lower-symmetry ordered models and other discrete element/site assignments were not comparably instantiated and optimized. P-3m1 was inferred because that constrained P321 realization already formed inversion-related pairs, not selected against refined lower-symmetry competitors. Physical plausibility is also concerning: the model gives Ge only two near S neighbors at about 2.47 A (plus six Cu contacts), Cu threefold S coordination, and Mg sixfold S coordination, unlike the expected tetrahedral Cu/Mg/Ge sulfide framework. Thus the fit strongly supports the cell and a layered average density, but not uniquely the submitted symmetry, coordinates, full occupancies, or element ordering; a materially different, chemically motivated model could plausibly improve the candidate set.
